title: Tribute to 5POINTZ
altText: Stunning 3D tribute graffiti mural to New York 5Pointz by Mr Blob, featuring the iconic building turned into a boombox truck, breakdancers, corporate businessmen, and a 5 Lives On flag on a torn paper background.
description: Painted in 2014 at the Leoncavallo free wall in Milan, this piece pays homage to 5Pointz, the legendary New York graffiti landmark demolished that same year. The iconic building is reimagined as a graffiti-covered boombox truck surrounded by b-boys and writers, while a giant mouse-eared figure with "BLOB" tattooed across its knuckles looms over fleeing businessmen. On the torn-paper background, a sketched city skyline and a flag declare that "5 lives on".
